name: D'pur
description: D'pur was the seventh planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system within the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds. It was the only gas giant in the system.
lead_paragraphs: D'pur was the seventh planet orbiting the star C'rel in the N'zoth system within the Koornacht Cluster of the Core Worlds. It was the only gas giant in the system.
